title: Submatrix
text: Select subset of elements (submatrix) from matrix input, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Row span} sets Range of; {Row} sets the first row, {Starting row} sets the first row, {Row index} sets the index of first row, {Starting row index} sets the index of first row, {Row offset} sets the offset of first row, {Starting row offset} sets the offset of first row, {Ending row} sets the last row, {Ending row index} sets the index of last row, {Ending row offset} sets the offset of last row, {Column span} sets the range of input, {Column} sets the first column, {Starting column} sets the first column, {Starting column index} sets the index of first column, {Column index} sets the index of first column, {Column offset} sets the offset of first column, {Starting column offset} sets the offset of first column, {Ending column} sets the last column, {Ending column index} sets the index of last column and {Ending column offset} sets the offset of last column. Values come from the instance.
